column1: # تنوین نصب — دستور خطّ فارسی (ویراست جدید)، ص ۵۶.
# «آوردن تنوین، درصورتی‌که تلفّظ شود، در همهٔ متون الزامی است.»
# Left column: the bare form (no tanvin). Right column: the form the
# standard requires. The alef carries the tanvin, per rule 1 on that page.
# ابدا، اصلا and مطلقا are deliberately absent: footnote 1 on the same page
# says those three may be read without the tanvin, so their bare form is not
# an error. جدا, بنا and عرفا are absent because each is also an ordinary
# Persian word that carries no tanvin at all.
# The first block is printed in the standard. The second applies the same
# clause to common Arabic adverbs it does not print — see the rule's notes.
